# Source attribution

The simulation, particle shape, palette and default settings are adapted from the Google Antigravity homepage effect in the supplied `MainParticlesComponent.astro_astro_type_script_index_0_lang.Dox4` file. That file matched the [homepage script](https://antigravity.google/_astro/MainParticlesComponent.astro_astro_type_script_index_0_lang.Dox42TL8.js) when checked on September 10, 2026.

The reusable renderer, instance API, lifecycle handling and sampling implementation are separate readable modules. The saved site bundles are reference material and are not imported by this component.

The 3D simplex noise function is by Ian McEwan, Ashima Arts. Its [MIT license](https://github.com/ashima/webgl-noise/blob/master/LICENSE) is included in `src/noise.glsl.js` and retained in both generated builds.
